objective: Restore and tracking only act on regular files whose real location lies under the user's home. Anything else fails closed before any write.
problem: Code review of backup-restore found two high findings. (1) validate only requires an absolute path, so a planted manifest can make restore write or delete any file the user can reach (restore.go:223,229; store.go:63-66). (2) inspect, removeFile and Track only Lstat the last component, so a symlinked parent directory redirects writes outside home (restore.go:61-77,258,261-286; backup.go:114).
